Operations.Name: CloudBackupAbort
Operations.Description: Abort a running cloud backup task.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the cloud backup task whose backup job to abort.

Operations.Name: CloudBackupCreate
Operations.Description: Create a new cloud backup task

Arguments.Name: cloud_backup
Arguments.Description: Configuration for the new cloud backup task.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the cloud backup task to delete.

Operations.Name: CloudBackupDeleteSnapshot
Operations.Description: Delete snapshot `snapshot_id` created by the cloud backup job `id`.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: The cloud backup task ID.

Arguments.Name: snapshot_id
Arguments.Description: ID of the snapshot to delete.

Operations.Name: CloudBackupGetInstance
Operations.Description:
Returns instance matching `id`. If `id` is not found, Validation error is raised.

Please see `query` method documentation for `options`.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Query options customize the results returned by a query method. More complete documentation with examples     are covered in the "Query methods" section of the TrueNAS API documentation.

Operations.Name: CloudBackupListSnapshotDirectory
Operations.Description: List files in the directory `path` of the `snapshot_id` created by the cloud backup job `id`.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: The cloud backup task ID.

Arguments.Name: snapshot_id
Arguments.Description: ID of the snapshot whose contents to list.

Arguments.Name: path
Arguments.Description: Path within the snapshot to list the contents of.

Operations.Name: CloudBackupListSnapshots
Operations.Description: List existing snapshots for the cloud backup job `id`.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: The cloud backup task ID.

Arguments.Name: filters
Arguments.Description: List of filters for query results. See API documentation for "Query Methods" for more guidance.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Query options including pagination, ordering, and additional parameters.

Operations.Name: CloudBackupRestore
Operations.Description:
Restore files to the directory `destination_path` from the `snapshot_id` subfolder `subfolder`
created by the cloud backup job `id`.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the cloud backup task.

Arguments.Name: snapshot_id
Arguments.Description: ID of the snapshot to restore.

Arguments.Name: subfolder
Arguments.Description: Path within the snapshot to restore.

Arguments.Name: destination_path
Arguments.Description: Local path to restore to.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Additional restore options.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: The cloud backup task ID.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Sync options.

Operations.Name: CloudBackupUpdate
Operations.Description: Update the cloud backup entry `id` with `data`.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the cloud backup task to update.

Arguments.Name: data
Arguments.Description: Updated configuration data for the cloud backup task.

Models.Name: CloudBackup
Models.Description: Configuration for the new cloud backup task.

Fields.Name: AbsolutePaths
Fields.Description: Preserve absolute paths in each backup (cannot be set when `snapshot=True`).

Fields.Name: Args
Fields.Description: (Slated for removal).

Fields.Name: Attributes
Fields.Description: Additional information for each backup, e.g. bucket name.

Fields.Name: CachePath
Fields.Description: Cache path. If not set, performance may degrade.

Fields.Name: Credentials
Fields.Description: ID of the cloud credential to use for each backup.

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: The name of the task to display in the UI.

Fields.Name: Enabled
Fields.Description: Can enable/disable the task.

Fields.Name: Exclude
Fields.Description: Paths to pass to `restic backup --exclude`.

Fields.Name: Include
Fields.Description: Paths to pass to `restic backup --include`.

Fields.Name: KeepLast
Fields.Description: How many of the most recent backup snapshots to keep after each backup.

Fields.Name: Password
Fields.Description: Password for the remote repository.

Fields.Name: Path
Fields.Description: The local path to back up beginning with `/mnt` or `/dev/zvol`.

Fields.Name: PostScript
Fields.Description: A Bash script to run immediately after every backup if it succeeds.

Fields.Name: PreScript
Fields.Description: A Bash script to run immediately before every backup.

Fields.Name: RateLimit
Fields.Description:
Maximum upload/download rate in KiB/s. Passed to `restic --limit-upload` on `cloud_backup.sync` and     `restic --limit-download` on `cloud_backup.restore`. `null` indicates no rate limit will be imposed.

Can be overridden on a sync or restore call.

Fields.Name: Schedule
Fields.Description: Cron schedule dictating when the task should run.

Fields.Name: Snapshot
Fields.Description: Whether to create a temporary snapshot of the dataset before every backup.

Fields.Name: TransferSetting
Fields.Description:
* DEFAULT:
    * pack size given by `$RESTIC_PACK_SIZE` (default 16 MiB)
    * read concurrency given by `$RESTIC_READ_CONCURRENCY` (default 2 files)

* PERFORMANCE:
    * pack size = 29 MiB
    * read concurrency given by `$RESTIC_READ_CONCURRENCY` (default 2 files)

* FAST_STORAGE:
    * pack size = 58 MiB
    * read concurrency = 100 files
